integrity: The proof is elementary and covers every odd-order affine plane; finite tests corroborate but do not establish the universal theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Ideal pure qubit graph states, the full point-versus-line cut, odd-order finite affine planes, and at most two exactly omitted incidence gates only; no noise, partial phase gates, three-or-more faults, or other partitions; historical priority and independent scientific validation remain open.
title: Parallel-line two-gate entropy loss in odd-order affine-plane graph states
